review.rationale: Builder-LLM review of the os_account IAccountIAM manage-credential family: the system API reference declares MANAGE_USER_IDM on each JS section, and the C++ service method (declared with the same name modulo capitalization) checks PERMISSION_MANAGE_USER_IDM through its private CheckPermission helper before the InnerAccountIAMManager operation. Applicability is a Builder-LLM mapping from JS API sections to IDL methods; it does not establish that the expected authorization policy is independently verified.
